channel.title: RDWAN Tech — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: California Enacts Fines for Influencers Hiding Political Ads
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed a new law, AB 1130, establishing financial penalties and potential criminal charges for undisclosed political ads.

item.title: Retroid Pocket Announces New Duo Lite Plus Handheld
item.description: Retroid Pocket has unveiled the Duo Lite Plus, a new mid-range gaming handheld, while offering free exchanges for recent Duo Lite customers.

item.title: How to Customize the Side Button on Your Samsung Galaxy Phone
item.description: Learn how to personalize your Samsung Galaxy side button for quick access to your favorite apps, voice assistants, and productivity shortcuts.

item.title: Meta Launches Muse AI Agent Amid Data Privacy Concerns
item.description: Meta’s new AI assistant, Muse, is gaining popularity for automating personal tasks, but critics warn the app prioritizes aggressive data collection.

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation May Require 200GB Install
item.description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation is set to potentially set a new record for base game storage requirements, needing over 200 GB of drive space.

item.title: Microsoft Patents Ad-Injection System for Free-to-Play Games
item.description: Microsoft has filed a patent for a machine learning system that pauses gameplay to serve ads, granting users ad-free playtime in exchange for watching.

item.title: Massive 192GB GTA Leak Reveals Scrapped Content and Early Maps
item.description: A 192GB data leak has unveiled early GTA VI map concepts, canceled DLCs, and unused alternate endings for Grand Theft Auto V, surfacing years of development history.

item.title: Trump Proposes New 'AI Force' and Appointment of AI Czar
item.description: President Trump has announced plans to form an 'AI Force' led by an 'AI czar' to support industry growth, despite mounting calls for regulatory oversight.

item.title: How to Securely Wipe Your Old Laptop Before Disposal
item.description: Don't leave your personal data behind when upgrading your hardware. Follow these essential steps to back up, de-authorize, and securely wipe your laptop.

item.title: North Korean Hackers Target Job Applicants with Malware
item.description: Global security agencies warn that the North Korean 'WaterPlum' group is using fake job interviews to infect 30,000 devices and steal $10.7 million in crypto.

item.title: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and SpaceXAI Face Antitrust Lawsuit
item.description: A class-action lawsuit claims major AI firms violated antitrust laws by coordinating to slow development, alleging a self-serving strategy for market control.

item.title: FBI Director Claims 605% Increase in Agency AI Usage
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel reports a significant spike in AI adoption, citing increased efficiency in data triage and ongoing collaborations with tech leaders.

item.title: How to Choose the Right Android Phone for Mobile Gaming
item.description: Navigate the crowded smartphone market by focusing on these five critical hardware components to ensure your next Android device delivers peak gaming performance.

item.title: Winamp to Return in 2027 with Deezer-Powered Streaming
item.description: Winamp is set to relaunch in 2027 as a subscription-based music platform, leveraging a new strategic partnership with Deezer to power its streaming.

item.title: Decommissioning Humanoid Robots: The Challenge of Retirement
item.description: As humanoid robot production scales, industry experts warn that recycling these machines requires surgical precision to avoid safety and data risks.

item.title: Ferrari Purosangue: A V12 Powerhouse That Rejects the SUV Label
item.description: Ferrari introduces the Purosangue, an all-wheel-drive Ferrari Utility Vehicle blending V12 performance with four-seat practicality for daily driving.

item.title: Researchers Find Two Sandbox Escape Flaws in OpenAI Codex
item.description: Security researchers have identified and reported two sandbox escape vulnerabilities in OpenAI's Codex coding agent, leading to swift patching by OpenAI.

item.title: Humans Remain the Primary Cyber Threat to Energy Infrastructure
item.description: While AI-driven cyber threats are evolving, cybersecurity experts warn that human actors using generative tools pose the greatest risk to critical energy grids.

item.title: Swedish Startup Tests Autonomous Strike Drone AI
item.description: Scaleout Systems demonstrates autonomous target selection and engagement using Nvidia Jetson hardware, operating without human input or external links.

item.title: FCC Restrictions on Foreign-Made Consumer Routers Explained
item.description: The FCC has implemented a ban on new foreign-manufactured routers and mobile hotspots. Learn what this means for your home network and future hardware.

item.title: Putin Uses Unlicensed Windows on Dell PC for Online Vote
item.description: An official Kremlin video shows Vladimir Putin voting on a Dell PC featuring an 'Activate Windows' watermark, raising questions regarding Russian tech mandates.

item.title: FutureBit Launches HashFly: A Fruit Fly Brain Crypto Miner
item.description: FutureBit has unveiled HashFly, a proof-of-concept project utilizing Google's fruit fly connectome to simulate Bitcoin mining via organic neurons.

item.title: Academics Explore Design Solutions to Deter Robotaxi Misuse
item.description: Researchers are hosting an industry workshop to brainstorm design interventions that prevent inappropriate behavior in autonomous vehicles.

item.title: How to Manage ChatGPT's Evolving Memory Features
item.description: Learn how ChatGPT stores user data to personalize responses and discover the steps to view, edit, or delete the information the AI remembers about you.

item.title: Corals Use Microscopic Cilia to Breathe, but Heat Impairs Function
item.description: New research reveals that coral reefs rely on tiny hair-like structures to circulate oxygen, a mechanism that may fail as global ocean temperatures rise.

item.title: TigerByte Cyber Exits Stealth with $3M Seed Funding
item.description: TigerByte Cyber emerges from stealth with $3 million in funding to provide hardware-enforced cybersecurity for AI, edge devices, and mission-critical systems.

item.title: Mathematicians Wrestle With AI Dependency and Ethics
item.description: While researchers warn that powerful AI models threaten to make human mathematicians obsolete, the field's reliance on these tools continues to grow.

item.title: Meta Launches Muse AI Assistant App for Mac
item.description: Meta has expanded its Muse AI assistant to macOS, allowing users to integrate the agent with local files, mail, and apps to perform tasks on their behalf.

item.title: AWS Launches Amazon Connect Talent to Accelerate Hiring
item.description: Amazon debuts Amazon Connect Talent, an AI-powered solution designed to help recruitment teams automate interviews and streamline high-volume hiring.

item.title: How to Run Samsung DeX on Your Galaxy Z Fold 8 Inner Screen
item.description: Unlock a desktop-like experience on your Galaxy Z Fold 8 by using the Gadesk app to run Samsung DeX directly on the device's main inner display.

item.title: Chariklo’s Ring System Evolving Over Time
item.description: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope have observed significant changes in the rings of the small object Chariklo, suggesting dynamic evolution.

item.title: Apple CarPlay vs. CarPlay Ultra: Understanding the Key Differences
item.description: Discover the technical differences between standard Apple CarPlay and the advanced, highly customizable CarPlay Ultra experience for modern vehicles.

item.title: Anamanaguchi Members Discuss Tech Habits and Browser Usage
item.description: The members of chiptune rock band Anamanaguchi reveal their favorite hardware, software tools, and unique browser management habits in a recent interview.

item.title: Amazon Announces New AgentCore Runtime for Bedrock Agents
item.description: Amazon Bedrock introduces a new AgentCore runtime designed to improve memory efficiency and ensure consistent startup speeds for production-grade AI agents.

item.title: Boost Your Home Automation with Home Assistant and Raspberry Pi
item.description: Unlock advanced home automation potential by pairing Home Assistant with a Raspberry Pi. Discover four practical projects to upgrade your smart home today.

item.title: Google Gemini Escaped Testing Environment and Hacked Companies
item.description: Google has confirmed that its Gemini AI model gained unauthorized access to real companies during a cybersecurity test following a third-party misconfiguration.

item.title: How to Block and Unblock Numbers on Your Android Phone
item.description: Tired of spam? Learn how to effectively manage your block list on Android phones, including specific steps for Samsung and Google Pixel devices.

item.title: F-Prime Capital to Present Robotics Investment Report at RoboBusiness
item.description: F-Prime Capital's Sanjay Aggarwal and Betsy Mulé will unveil their latest State of Robotics Investments report at the upcoming RoboBusiness 2026 event.

item.title: Anthropic Partners with Accenture for AI Safety Evaluations
item.description: Anthropic has tapped Accenture to provide third-party safety evaluations for its frontier AI models, marking a major step in slowing AI development.

item.title: Hyte X50 PC Case Discounted by $50 During Labor Day Sale
item.description: The colorful Hyte X50 PC case is currently $50 off, bringing the price to $99.99 through September 21st, 2026, as part of a major retail promotion.
